name: Kramarczuk's Sausage Company
type: restaurant, deli, bakery and meat market
whatItIs: Eastern European deli, bakery and sausage maker founded in 1954 by Ukrainian refugees Wasyl and Anna Kramarczuk; owned by their son Orest. 2013 James Beard America's Classic award. Sausages sold at Target Field.
evidence: Own site lists hours (Tuesday-Saturday 10-8) and holiday closings including Thursday, Nov. 26 (Thanksgiving 2026), with a 2026 copyright.

name: Heaven Gluten Free
whatItIs: Gluten-free vegan sourdough bakery founded in 2023 by Polina and Vlad Lahoda, who came from Kyiv in 2022. Sells online with nationwide shipping and through local stores.
evidence: Own site is taking orders and shows customer reviews dated Sept. and Oct. 2026 (latest 10/20/2026).

name: Ukrainian Gift Shop
whatItIs: Family business founded in 1947 by Marie Procai and Luba Perchyshyn; sells pysanky dyes, kits, design books and embroidery. No walk-in showroom; pickup by appointment.
evidence: Online store is live with products, pickup instructions and a 2026 copyright, but no dated 2025 or 2026 post or current hours were found. Its history page refers to the 76th anniversary in 2023.

name: Ukrainian Village Band
whatItIs: Ukrainian roots and 'zabava' party band founded in 2007; plays traditional and modern Ukrainian music and rock covers, organizes concerts and an Ivana Kupala festival.
evidence: The Cedar Cultural Center listed a show on Aug. 20, 2025; the Minnesota State Fair's schedule page lists the band on the Summit Stage Aug. 31 and Sept. 1; FOX 9 credited the band at the Aug. 24, 2025 Independence Day gathering.

name: Ukrainian American Community Center (UACCMN)
type: community center, event hall and food sales
whatItIs: Founded in 1964; fraternal, cultural and refugee-service center. Hosts the Ukrainian Festival of Minnesota, a Lenten fish fry with online ordering, a holiday bazaar and event rentals.
evidence: Site shows current programs, staff and a 2026 copyright; St. Michael's and St. George's events page promoted its 2026 Ukrainian fish fry (Feb. 20, 2026). Building under major renovation; 2026 festival postponed to Sept. 17-18, 2027.

name: Protez Foundation
neighborhoodOrCity: Twin Cities (Oakdale fundraiser; patients treated in Minnesota) and Ukraine
whatItIs: Free prosthetic care and rehabilitation for Ukrainians who lost limbs in the war, founded in Minnesota in 2022 by Ukrainian-born prosthetist Yakov Gradinar and CEO Yura Aroshidze; runs Protez Academy with Century College.
evidence: Own site posts news dated Sept. 23, 2026 and results for May 2022 to October 2026.

name: YEV Music (Yev Rosso)
whatItIs: Singer-songwriter with Ukrainian roots whose music draws on being a Ukrainian immigrant in the Midwest.
evidence: Only source is a 2023 Shoreview Press preview of an Oct. 1, 2023 performance; no 2025 or 2026 activity found.
